command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0103/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The 0.67.0 call/rel32 row in three shapes: call L1 resolves in place (e8 05 00 00 00; L1 is at offset 10 and the instruction ends at 5), call ext assembles to e8 00 00 00 00 with one R_X86_64_PLT32 ext -4 record, and call .+130 is the literal field 125 (e8 7d 00 00 00). The addq is the 0.1.0 row that hosts L1. input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 19-byte .text.
relocation_check: llvm-readobj --relocations reports one record: 0x6 R_X86_64_PLT32 ext 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFC; the .Ltmp0+130 literal resolves in place and emits none
